entry.when: no option position is open for this strategy
entry.expiry_rule: the tradeable expiry whose days-to-expiry is closest to target_dte
entry.strike_rule: the listed strike closest to the expiry's median forward; both legs must be two-sided
entry.fill_rule: sell at the bid, buy at the ask; no mid fills

exit.note: Deribit options inside one day of expiry drop out of the live chain, so the position is closed while it is still quoted. An instrument that disappears anyway, because a run was missed, is settled at intrinsic against the shortest-dated forward and the row is flagged imputed.

sizing.note: One contract is one BTC of inverse option. Size is fixed, never scaled by conviction, signal strength or past P&L.

hedging.delta_source: our refined arbitrage-checked surface, not the venue mark

costs.option_taker_fee: min(0.03% of the forward, 12.5% of the option premium) per contract
costs.slippage: the full quoted spread is paid on every fill
costs.funding: none modelled; the hedge is a dated forward, not a perpetual

marking.schedule: once per day at the scheduled run
marking.price: venue mid of bid and ask
marking.fallback: our surface price when a leg has no two-sided quote
marking.equity_definition: cash plus position value; the book starts at zero cash, so equity is cumulative profit and loss in USD

notes: The plainest systematic option strategy that exists, pre-registered as the reference case. It uses the surface only for hedging. If the arbitrage-checked surface is worth anything, later strategies that trade on it have to beat this.
